entries.scope: Contain corrupted VM return frames at the shared execution boundary
entries.rationale: The observable stack-fault contract now rejects invalid non-root return-frame cells and dynamic links before register mutation, while preserving the compatible root halt and existing valid P-Code behavior.
readerPaths: VM instruction set to diagnostic contract and hosting guidance
Threat model to security scenario, checklist, and executable regression evidence
NuGet package README to structured stack-fault handling
entries.navigationImpact: No new navigation node; existing VM, hosting, package, architecture, and security reader paths are updated in place.
entries.languageStrategy: User-facing guidance remains German first and English second at CEFR B2; stable code and resource identifiers remain language-neutral.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The shared .NET VM kernel is exercised through direct instructions, mnemonic and numeric P-Code, batch and step execution, German and English resources, missing-resource fallbacks, corrupted links, the compatible root halt, and valid nested procedure returns.
entries.risk: Low after focused and full regression gates; broader frame-metadata integrity remains a separate architectural hardening decision.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: A change to CAL/OPR return layout, stack semantics, VM execution boundaries, diagnostics, localization, CLI/IDE presentation, or package behavior.
